adaptation_strategy.description: Freeze all hidden layers; retrain only the final classification layer on drifted data
adaptation_strategy.rationale: Preserves learned feature representations while adapting decision boundaries to new distribution

update_triggers.drift_threshold: PSI > 0.2 on any of top-10 TF-IDF features for >= 3 consecutive windows
update_triggers.kpi_drop: Rolling macro F1 drops > 0.05 below baseline for >= 2 monitoring windows
update_triggers.operational: New email domain onboarded, seasonal campaign detected, organizational restructure
update_triggers.label_acquisition: Weak supervision rules updated by domain expert; spot-check 200 emails per cycle

retraining_plans.mild_drift: Head fine-tuning (current approach) — fast, low cost, preserves representations
retraining_plans.moderate_drift: Full retrain with mixed old + new data (80/20 ratio) — preserves stability
retraining_plans.severe_drift: Full retrain on new data only + re-run feature_extraction.py to rebuild TF-IDF vocab

model_size.size_change: No change — head fine-tuning does not alter model architecture or size
